data.exact_reserve_text: In the 2014 calendar year, the 2014, 2013 and 2012 & prior years of account have all contributed profits (2014: GBP 19.7m; 2013: GBP 10.4m: 2012 & prior: GBP 39.7m). Syndicate 4444 has benefitted from positive reserve development relating to prior periods. An improvement in the old years' catastrophe events resulted in reserve releases across the Global Property and Global Specialty business units.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 900.631m. During 2014 the syndicate recorded material favourable reserve development on prior years, driven principally by improvements in older catastrophe-related claims. The managing agent reports that the 2013 and the 2012 & prior years of account contributed profits of GBP 10.4m and GBP 39.7m respectively (together c.GBP 50.1m of favourable development), resulting in a net prior-year release of approximately GBP 50.1m. Releases were concentrated in the Property and Global Specialty portfolios.

An improvement in the old years' catastrophe events resulted in reserve releases across the Global Property and Global Specialty business units.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2013 column). Prior year development derived from the Managing Agent narrative year-of-account breakdown (2013: GBP 10.4m; 2012 & prior: GBP 39.7m) and therefore represents the reported profitcontribution of prior years (interpreted as reserve releases of GBP 50.1m). The report does not provide a labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure; net run-off deviations by class are shown elsewhere but are net amounts and ambiguous for gross PYD allocation. Lob-level amounts for prior-year movements are not disclosed on a gross basis, so LOB movements are reported with null amounts and reduced confidence.
